Remark
[Nonlinear eigenvalue problem interpretation] ↗ thm:lagrange-multiplier-nonlinear-eigenvalue 1. ch8:8.4.1-rem-1\group Constrained Minimization

The minimizer $u$ is a weak solution of \[ \begin{cases} -\Delta u = \lambda g(u) & \text{in } U \\ u = 0 & \text{on } \partial U, \end{cases} \tag {11} \] where $\lambda $ is the Lagrange multiplier corresponding to the integral constraint \[ J[u] = 0. \tag {12} \] For $u\not\equiv 0$, (11) is a nonlinear eigenvalue problem for $(u,\lambda )$.
